title: Finite polynomial solutions factor through a smooth algebra
statement: Let $A$ and $\Lambda$ be commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $A\to\Lambda$ be a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. For $m,n\geq0$, let $f_j\in A[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ ($1\leq j\leq m$), and let $a_k\in\Lambda$ satisfy $f_j(a)=0$. There exist a commutative $A$-algebra $B$ whose affine structure morphism $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is smooth, an $A$-algebra map $\psi:B\to\Lambda$, and $b_1,\ldots,b_n\in B$ such that $f_j(b)=0$ and $\psi(b_k)=a_k$. Smoothness means locally of finite presentation, flat, with geometrically regular fibres. Polynomial rings here consist of finite sums of monomials with coefficients in $A$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0AH5 (lemma-henselian-pair), proof second paragraph; Theorem Tag 07GC; Algebra Lemma Tag 00QO

proof.text: Form C=A[x_1,...,x_n]/(f_1,...,f_m). The finite range of f generates its defining ideal, so Mathlib Algebra.FinitePresentation.quotient gives finite presentation. Evaluation at a kills that ideal and descends by Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ to an A-algebra map C→Λ. These are elementary polynomial-presentation and quotient constructions; the Lean proof writes them explicitly.
Apply Popescu to the regular map A→Λ of Noetherian rings, obtaining a filtered diagram of smooth A-algebras with colimit Λ in commutative rings and A-algebra coprojections.

Factor the finitely presented algebra C through one stage using RingHom.EssFiniteType.exists_eq_comp_ι_app_of_isColimit. Its structural-map compatibility turns the resulting ring hom into an A-algebra hom.

Let b_k be the stage image of the class of x_k. Applying the stage hom to the defining relations gives f_j(b)=0. Evaluating the factorization equality at x_k gives ψ(b_k)=a_k. Both calculations are written in Lean using MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp_left and quotient evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_polynomial_factorization
    {A Λ : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra A Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (hreg : RingHom.IsRegular (algebraMap A Λ)) {m n : ℕ}
    (f : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) (a : Fin n → Λ)
    (hzero : ∀ j, MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap A Λ) a (f j) = 0) :
    ∃ (B : CommAlgCat.{u} A),
      Smooth (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)).op) ∧
      ∃ (ψ : B →ₐ[A] Λ) (b : Fin n → B),
        (∀ j, MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap A B) b (f j) = 0) ∧
        (∀ k, ψ (b k) = a k)
